name: HashiCorp Agent Skills
summary: Official HashiCorp Agent Skills for Terraform (16) and Packer (4). MPL-2.0 pack in hashicorp/agent-skills; HashiCorp is an IBM company.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (HashiCorp, an IBM company). The hashicorp/agent-skills repository is MPL-2.0, not archived, and was pushed 2026-11-04. The pack is free to install; HashiCorp Cloud Platform or other paid product usage is separate and was not purchased. The README states that third-party MCP or LLM terms are the provider's, and that IBM is not responsible for those terms. Contributions are restricted to HashiCorp-internal contributors until further notice. Legacy plugin IDs were replaced by terraform@hashicorp and packer@hashicorp. Documented installs were not executed: `npx skills add hashicorp/agent-skills` (or path-specific skills), and Claude Code marketplace add followed by the terraform@hashicorp / packer@hashicorp plugins. A related official MCP is already listed as terraform-mcp-server. This skills entry does not set mcp_endpoint. No signup or spend.
